summary: Nokia filed a Form 6-K furnishing four managers' transactions notices under Article 19 of the EU Market Abuse Regulation, each disclosing the receipt of share-based incentive awards on 2026-10-15 outside a trading venue. Patrik Hammaren received 8,505 shares, David Heard 35,110, Pallavi Mahajan 35,192, and an additional manager a similar award; unit prices are marked N/A as these are non-market grants. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, or regulatory clock is disclosed because no transaction, tender, or strategic event exists. This is routine insider incentive reporting, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
